pipeline.title: Aruba
pipeline.description: Aruba IAP syslog extraction. Pulls process/pid, Aruba event id and severity tag (<NNNNNN> <SEV>), AP identity (name, IP, MAC), and station-event fields (client MAC, BSSID, ESSID) where present. Also categorizes into aruba_event_type for clean dashboard slicing.

rules.title: aruba extract base
rules.description: Pull process/pid, Aruba <event-id> <SEVERITY>, and the AP IP+MAC tag.

rules.title: aruba extract station
rules.description: When the message references a wifi client (mac-..., bssid-..., essid-...), pull those fields.

rules.title: aruba event type assoc
rules.source:
rule "aruba event type assoc"
when
  has_field("message") &&
  contains(to_string($message.source), "aruba") &&
  contains(to_string($message.message), "Assoc request")
then
  set_field("aruba_event_type", "client_assoc");
end

rules.title: aruba event type sta_update
rules.source:
rule "aruba event type sta_update"

rules.title: aruba event type drt
rules.description: Tag DRT (downloadable regulatory table) version-check noise so the dashboard can filter it out.
rules.source:
rule "aruba event type drt"
when
  has_field("message") &&
  contains(to_string($message.source), "aruba") &&
  contains(to_string($message.message), "drt version")
then
  set_field("aruba_event_type", "drt_version");
end
